description: This file defines the `Cloneable` template class within the `torch::nn` namespace. The class uses CRTP to provide a `clone()` method for deep copying modules, ensuring all parameters, buffers, and submodules are properly cloned with device management. It is intended to be inherited by hardware-specific or custom module classes that need clone functionality.

classes.name: Cloneable
classes.description: A CRTP template class that provides a deep cloning mechanism for modules, ensuring deep copy of parameters, buffers, and submodules, with device compatibility.

methods.name: std::shared_ptr<Module> clone(const std::optional<Device> & device=std::nullopt) const
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the module and its subcomponents, resetting internal states and copying parameters and buffers to a specified device if provided.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: An abstract method that derived classes must implement to initialize all members with reference semantics.

methods.name: void clone_(Module & other,const std::optional<Device> & device)
methods.description: A private method that clones submodules from the original module to the current one, ensuring type safety with dynamic casting.

ctags.name: clone_
ctags.pattern: /^  void clone_(Module& other, const std::optional<Device>& device) final {$/
